item.title: Conrack
item.description: A new teacher struggles to educate African American children who have been neglected in a poor community.

item.title: The Great White Hope
item.description: A black boxer and his white mistress face racial prejudice when he wins a championship match.

item.title: One in a Million: The Ron Leflore Story
item.description: Based on his autobiography, Ron Leflore must overcome addiction and stigma in order to become a star Major League baseball player for the Detroit Tigers.

item.title: Whitewash: The Clarence Brandley Story
item.description: Based on a true story, in 1981, Clarence Brandley, a young African American, is accused of rape and murder simply because of his skin color. With the help of a renegade legal team, he must go up against tainted testimony, stolen evidence, and century old prejudice.

item.title: The Autobiography of Miss Jane Pittman
item.description: A woman born into slavery joins the civil rights movement in the 1960s.
